run_tournament: run a chess tournament between multiple engines using ECO opening positions and output PGN games
play_game: play a single chess game between two engines with optional opening board and early stopping based on stockfish evaluation
build_engines: build a dictionary of chess engines from predefined agent names including stockfish and leela chess zero variants
load_openings: load chess opening positions from an ECO PGN file and subsample them for tournament play
run_tournament_cli: run the tournament CLI with --num_games flag to specify the number of games per engine pair
